You're Invited
Dear Friend,

Three years of growth, challenges, achievements, and unforgettable moments have brought us here — and you are part of that journey.

Join us this August 22–23, 2026, as we celebrate CrossCore OPC's 3rd Anniversary Team Building at Laxus Oasis Hot Spring Villa in Los Baños, Laguna.

This weekend is for us — to celebrate how far we've come, reconnect beyond work, and create another memory together as one CrossCore family.

We can't wait to celebrate with you.
